name: Ash Meyer
source:
A young man who abandoned his hometown and is always on the move from place to place. 
He prefers to be alone and does his best to avoid speaking to others—a quiet lone wolf.

Due to his surly appearance, he's constantly getting involved in fights, leading a life of never-ending violence.

He likes to drive vehicles and has a particularly strong attachment to motorcycles. 
He has amazing driving technique, but with how wild his driving is, it's a miracle he hasn’t been in an accident.

Hometown: Baden [Switzerland]
